daily_ops: Do not run opportunistic micro-tuning on production path

stop_rule.condition: No candidate reaches swap_typo uplift gate with mixed non-regression in current scoring/candidate framework.
action: Record hold decision in snapshot and artifacts

allowed_only_if: A structurally new decoding path is proposed (not metric-only or tie-break-only tweak)
Research branch isolates swap_typo logic from mixed path
A small-sample precheck shows positive swap_typo signal without mixed regression
entry_checklist: Define hypothesis and failure mode bucket mapping
Define rollback and feature flag boundaries
Pre-register gate criteria before running benchmark

go_no_go.go: swap_typo exact and recovery each improve by >= +0.02 with mixed delta >= -0.005
go_no_go.no_go: Any mixed regression beyond -0.005 or swap_typo uplift below +0.02

priority: Candidate generation redesign before reranking changes
Strict experiment isolation from production v4 path
deprioritized: Single-metric replacements only (e.g., distance function swap alone)
Tuple tie-break tuning without search-space redesign
Latency-increasing rerank layers without uplift signal
